titleEn: At the Alley End, Stop and Look!

pages.text: "First on the sled is the leader!" Kiki, the pointy-eared cat, led the way, pulling a sled. A snowy hill showed beyond the corner. Kiki kept running ahead.
"I want to get up the hill now!" Kiki stepped from the corner onto the main road. Gugu, the broad-chested pigeon, grabbed Kiki's hand. "Wait, Kiki!"
A snow cart rattled past, right in front. Its wheels left two long tracks. Kiki's heart raced, and the tail went stiff.
The awning rose, and Grandpa came out. "See those marks, Kiki?" He pointed at the wheel tracks. "Those lines show where carts travel."
The three stood before the tracks. "Stop right here, and you can see the main road." Kiki stretched the neck and looked left and right. "I can see so far!"
Nono, the smallest, roundest sparrow, raised both hands. "At the alley end, stop and look!" Gugu raised hands too. Kiki set the toes just before the tracks.
The cart passed, and the road grew quiet. Kiki raised a hand and held Grandpa's hand tightly. "At the alley end, stop and look!"
Grandpa and the three reached the other side together. Kiki touched the green bell. Jingle! "All three across!" Nono hopped.
Now Kiki's feet stopped at the alley end. "One, stop before the wheel tracks! Two, hand up! Three, look left and right, hold Grandpa's hand, and cross!" Coming back, Kiki stopped first.
Nono and Gugu held Kiki's hands on both sides. Even when you hurry, you can stop once. The hill will not run away. Kiki held the sled rope. "At the alley end, stop and look!"
